mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to potential monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, which in turn can cause negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% indicates a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply side of the economy, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines and SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is below 2%, the real interest rate is positive, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL < 2% and SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) suggests strong labor market conditions, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases and SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in real final sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines sharply and SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with a decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) suggests an expansionary monetary policy supporting supply-side growth, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases and FEDFUNDS decreases and SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
